entities.name: UE message processing
entities.description: UE shall process received RRC messages in order of reception, completing one message before starting the next.

entities.name: Procedure step execution
entities.description: UE shall execute procedural steps according to the order specified in the clause description.

entities.name: RRC Transaction Identifier
entities.description: Identifier used in RRC messages to correlate requests and responses.

entities.name: Choice value setup
entities.description: Condition when UE receives a choice value set to setup.

entities.name: Choice value release
entities.description: Condition when UE receives a choice value set to release.

entities.name: List extension condition
entities.description: Condition when the size of a list is extended with additional entries in an extension field.

entities.name: Configuration application
entities.description: UE applies received configuration and starts using associated resources when choice value is setup.

entities.name: Configuration clearing
entities.description: UE clears configuration and stops using associated resources when choice value is release.

entities.name: Combined list creation
entities.description: UE creates combined list by concatenating original and extension entries while maintaining order.

relations.description: Message processing includes executing procedural steps in specified order.
Transaction identifier handling is part of UE message processing requirements.
Receiving choice value setup establishes configuration application behavior.
Receiving choice value release establishes configuration clearing behavior.
List extension condition establishes combined list creation behavior.
